newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gateway 2000 buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gateway 2000 buy repeated.

text.p: - Nutmeg Securities said it repeated a buy rating on Gateway 2000 Inc.

- Analyst Charles Drummond III said he believes the market overreacted to yesterday's news regarding some technology companies. Yesterday, Gateway shares closed off 4-7/16 to 40-5/8 after two technology companies issued disappointing earnings outlooks.
- He said Gateway, a direct marketer of computers and computer equipment, has a very efficient distribution system. He expects Gateway to outperform in the near and longer term.
- Gateway shares are currently trading up 1-1/2 to 42-1/8.
